items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed a formal EEO complaint alleging that the Agency discriminated against her based on race (Hispanic) and national origin (Mexican).

By letter dated [MASK], the Agency accepted the formal complaint for investigation and framed the claims in the following fashion: Whether a co-worker who was an On-the-Job Instructor (OJI), as well as a Lead, subjected Complainant to harassment based on her race/national origin (Hispanic/Mexican) on multiple occasions beginning in June 2020 and continuing through July 2021 when, among other matters, the OJI/Lead: 1.

Complainant’s uncorroborated statements that management was motivated by race/ethnicity and/or national origin to take the actions complained of are not sufficient to sustain her burden of showing harassment…Finally, we note that Complainant’s allegations of harassment were addressed through an internal anti-harassment inquiry, which did not substantiate [MASK]’s claims.” FAD at 13.
[MASK] asserts that the Agency’s final decision did not properly set forth that the alleged harasser was initially her former manager (prior to serving as her Lead and OJI).
[MASK] asserts that she provided notice to S2 regarding S1’s behavior and requested a change of supervisor, but that S2 ignored the harassment and allowed the behavior to continue.
